markers.title: C9 and no voice: S1-75's code by call or text to the listing's phone

targets.line: To prove Lee's Barbershop is yours, I'm calling the number on your listing with a code: (555) 010-0177. Type the code here.
A code by call, text or email to the public listing's own phone or email, typed back here.

markers.why: MC C9; Q-02 (the code goes only to the listing's email); arch 12 line 634 (Phone calls, D5); C-237

markers.title: C9 and no voice: S1-35's texted and called notice to the listing's phone

targets.line: The notice goes to the phone and email on the public listing. The registration's contact gets it only with no listing.
A landline gets it by a call: 'This is Rosie, an automated assistant. <Business> is now on Rosie. Not you? Call Rosie's team.'

markers.why: MC C9; Q-02 (the go-live notice goes by email only); arch 12 line 634
